rows.title_full: AN ACT LEGALIZING EUTHANASIA IN CERTAIN CASES (mercy killing)
rows.abstract: "The Right to Die Act" Defines the terms "PASSIVE EUTHANASIA" and "VOLUNTARY EUTHANASIA" as used in this Act. Declares that EUTHANASIA, whether passive or voluntary, shall be ALLOWED as a practice in the Republic of the Philippines. Declares, further, the EXEMPTION of any person who participates in the performace of euthanasia FROM any criminal, civil or administrative liability.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1995-10-26

rows.author: A101
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING GENERAL AMNESTY FOR YOUTHFUL OFFENDERS CONVICTED BY FINAL JUDGEMENT
rows.abstract: Defines "YOUTHFUL OFFENDER" as any individual over nine (9) years, but under 21 years of age. States that a youthful offender who has been convicted of final judgment shall upon application, be granted GENERAL AMNESTY, provide he/she is NOT a recidivist nor a habitual offender.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-10-26

rows.abstract: "Ejectment of Lessees with Expired Contracts Act" Declares that any decision of a MUNICIPAL TRIAL COURT in cases of UNLAWFUL DETAINER based on the expiration of a contract of lease which has been final shall BE immediately EXECUTORY, WITH OR WITHOUTAN APPEAL taken by the LESSEE.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-10-26

rows.abstract: Focuses on the local Disaster Coordinating councils for them to become more self-reliant and effective in providing disaster relief services. Provides for the planning for disaster operations, as well as compensatory benefits for the disaster volunteer worker who inrease death or injury during civil defense activities.

rows.abstract: Requires employees in private enterprises to disseminate information regarding occupational hazards and the dangers they pose to the workers' health and safety. Presribes penalty for failure to comply.
